name: Camping Stigger Innsbruck - Völs
beschreibung: Camping Stigger Innsbruck - Völs is situated on the outskirts of Innsbruck, close to the western district of Völs. The campsite offers pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents, as well as direct access to the Inn Cycle Path. Innsbruck city center can be reached in just a few minutes. The grounds are framed by meadows and a gentle stream bordering the site. Guests can take advantage of a small shop, well-equipped sanitary facilities, and a barbecue area.
